extra_quotes: Experimental results show that the SMU architecture utilizes only 37,6% of LUTs, 9,4% of FFs, and 35,9% of BRAM.
Furthermore, this low resource utilization allow to achieve 40,48 ms reconfiguration time, using OSS-CAD-Suite including gmpack v1.13.

To measure it, the bitstream packed by GMpack 1.13 has been uploaded to the SPI flash memory on the GateMate M1A1 evaluation board and FPGA reconfiguration times were measured with the SIGLENT SDS2104X oscilloscope [24], starting at the de-assertion of the RESET signal until the rising edge of CFG_DONE signal.
In our design the main bottleneck was the number of BRAM available in the GateMate FPGA.
